status: experimental
description: Detects initial access via unauthenticated HTTP GET request to vulnerable HFS instance with null byte injection and command execution syntax in search parameter.
references:
    - https://vk9-sec.com/hfs-code-execution-cve-2014-6287/
    - https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/39161

author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1203
logsource:
    category: webserver_access_log
    product: http
    service: hfs
detection:
    selection:
        cs-uri-query|contains:
            - '/?search=%00{\.exec|'
            - '%00{\.exec|'
            - 'search='
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative access using search parameter
    - Automated security scanning tools accessing HFS with search parameter
level: high

title: Execution via HFS Command Injection CVE-2014-6287
id: 9a1b2c3d-4e5f-6a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d

description: Detects execution stage of HFS command injection exploit by monitoring for PowerShell or command execution patterns in process creation logs.

    - https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/39161
    - https://github.com/Twigonometry/Cybersecurity-Notes/blob/c875b0f52df7d2c7a870e75e1f0c2679d417931d/Writeups/Hack%20the%20Box/Boxes/Optimum/10%20-%20Website.md
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_img:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\cmd.exe'
    selection_cmd:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '.exec|'
    condition: all of selection_ *
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative scripts using PowerShell or CMD
    - Security tools performing automated system checks
level: high
